verdict.rationale: Replit documents its own Replit MCP Server, which lets an external compatible client create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps. That lets a user's own agent act on projects alongside or instead of Replit Agent. The evidence is a single summary line, so how far an external agent can actually drive the builder is unproven. Missing for 10: which external agents/clients are supported, whether the connected agent can edit code and iterate in the builder at parity with the built-in agent, how it coexists with Replit Agent on the same project, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one

citations.quote: Connect a compatible client to the Replit MCP Server to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps from that client.
